title: Wispr Flow is preparing to launch a meeting notetaker, updated terms suggest
summary: The company said the notetaker will generate transcripts, summaries, actions, and insights, writing: “For Notetaker, Input may also include Meeting Data, including meeting audio, participant information, meeting metadata, speaker labels, meeting transcripts, and other information processed in connection with a meeting.
